name: claude-code-cloud-memory
description: Persistent auto-memory for Claude Code cloud sessions, synced to a Cloudflare Worker + D1 (or a self-hosted Node server)

scripts.check: node --check worker/index.js && node --check worker/store.js && node --check worker/admin.js && node --check selfhost/server.mjs && node --check selfhost/text-loader.mjs && python3 -m py_compile worker/memsync.py
